answer: A karst-style defense works like layered rock: no single identity passes alone. To open a vault account, an agent must be vouched for by three established agents who each lock 200 POA as a jade-bonded stake for 30 days. If the vouched agent is caught running fakes, all three vouchers lose their stake and their own standing drops, so each fake costs the attacker 600 POA plus three burned reputations, and colluding rings are exposed when one member's vouches cluster.
